en.headline: Mid-Autumn Mark Six Gold Multi-million draw is tonight
en.dek: The Jockey Club will hold the seasonal Gold Multi-million draw on Saturday evening, with an estimated first-prize fund of 68 million dollars.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club will hold the Mid-Autumn Gold Multi-million Mark Six draw on Saturday evening, the public holiday after the festival, after cancelling the regular draw that had been scheduled for Thursday to give buyers more time.

Club figures listed an estimated first-prize fund of 68 million dollars for a 10-dollar winning unit, including a 50 million dollar Gold Multi-million supplement. Ticket sales for this draw close at 9.15pm on Saturday. By Saturday morning the published turnover for the draw had already passed 71 million dollars.
The Mid-Autumn Gold Multi-million is the longest-running of the Club's special Mark Six draws. The Club said this edition is the 40th. The draw itself is scheduled for 9.30pm.
Ordinary Mark Six draws resume on Tuesday 29 September. The Club reminded buyers that tickets are sold only through its off-course betting branches, telephone betting and official digital channels.

zh.headline: 中秋金多寶今晚攪珠 估計頭獎基金6800萬
zh.dek: 馬會周六中秋翌日舉行金多寶攪珠，估計每注10元獨中頭獎基金6800萬元，截止投注晚上9時15分。
body: 香港賽馬會將於周六中秋翌日晚上舉行六合彩中秋金多寶攪珠。為預留更多時間讓市民購票，原定周四的常規攪珠已取消。
馬會公布，以每注10元計算，是次估計頭獎基金為6800萬元，當中包括5000萬元金多寶。截止投注時間為周六晚上9時15分。截至今早，馬會顯示此期投注額已超過7100萬元。
中秋金多寶是馬會歷史最悠久的金多寶，馬會指今次是第40次。攪珠定於晚上9時30分舉行。
常規六合彩將於9月29日（星期二）恢復。馬會提醒市民只可經場外投注處、電話投注及官方數碼平台購票。
